title: Least but not Last: Fine-tuning Intermediate Principal Components for Better Performance-Forgetting Trade-Offs
abstract: arXiv:2602.03493v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) methods have emerged as crucial techniques for adapting large pre-trained models to downstream tasks under computational and memory constraints. However, they face a fundamental challenge in balancing task-specific performance gains against catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge, where existing methods provide inconsistent recommendations. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the performance-forgetting trade-offs inherent in low-rank adaptation using principal components of weight matrices as initialization. Our investigation reveals that fine-tuning intermediate components leads to better balance and robustness to high learning rates than first (PiSSA) and last (MiLoRA) components in existing work. translated_title: 最少但非最后：微调中间主成分以获得更优的性能-遗忘权衡
translated_abstract: 低秩适配方法已成为在计算与内存约束下将大型预训练模型适配到下游任务的关键技术。然而，这类方法面临一个根本性挑战：如何在任务特定性能提升与预训练知识的灾难性遗忘之间取得平衡，而现有方法对此给出的建议并不一致。本文对以权重矩阵主成分作为初始化的低秩适配中固有的性能-遗忘权衡进行了全面分析。我们的研究表明，与现有工作中使用前部主成分的PiSSA和使用末部主成分的MiLoRA相比，微调中间主成分能够带来更好的平衡性以及对高学习率的鲁棒性。基于这些发现，我们为LoRA方法的初始化提供了实用指南，以平衡性能与遗忘之间的权衡。在一项针对多种（任务/模型）的深入实证研究中……
tldr: 该论文发现用权重矩阵的中间主成分初始化并微调LoRA，相比使用前部主成分（PiSSA）或末部主成分（MiLoRA）的方法，能在任务性能与灾难性遗忘之间取得更优且对高学习率更鲁棒的权衡。
en_tdlr: Fine-tuning LoRA adapters initialized with the intermediate principal components of weight matrices achieves a better and more robust performance-forgetting trade-off than using the first (PiSSA) or last (MiLoRA) components.
